question: What are the top 10 product categories by total item price?
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_item_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY total_item_price DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which sellers generated the highest total item price?
expected_sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS total_item_price FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_item_price DESC;

question: Which customer states have the most orders?
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: Which customer states generated the most total item price?
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS total_item_price FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_item_price DESC;

question: Which product categories have the highest average product price?
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, AVG(oi.price) AS average_product_price FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY average_product_price DESC;

question: Which 10 product categories have the most products?
expected_sql: SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which sellers generated more than 10,000 in total item price?
expected_sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS total_item_price FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING SUM(price) > 10000 ORDER BY total_item_price DESC;

question: What is the total payment value for each payment type?
expected_sql: SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total_payment_value DESC;

question: What is the average review score for each customer state?
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(r.review_score) AS average_review_score FROM reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_review_score DESC;

question: What percentage of reviews have a score of 5?
expected_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_five_star_reviews FROM reviews;

question: What percentage of orders were delivered?
expected_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS delivered_order_percentage FROM orders;

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2018?
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: What is the average number of payment installments for each payment type?
expected_sql: SELECT payment_type, AVG(payment_installments) AS average_installments FROM payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY average_installments DESC;

question: Which seller states have the highest number of sellers?
expected_sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC;

question: What is the average freight value for each seller?
expected_sql: SELECT seller_id, AVG(freight_value) AS average_freight_value FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY average_freight_value DESC;
